issue.title: Add a dark mode to the settings page

summary: A Theme setting with light, dark and system choices. The choice is saved in local storage and applied to the page root as a data-theme attribute before first paint.
acceptance_criteria: The settings page offers Light, Dark and System.
The chosen theme survives a reload.
System follows the operating system's preference and reacts when it changes.
No flash of the wrong theme on first paint.

files.reason: Reads, saves and applies the theme.

tests.name: the chosen theme survives a reload
tests.behaviour: set('dark') then a new ThemeStore().get() is 'dark'.

tests.name: system follows the OS preference
tests.behaviour: With 'system' saved and the OS preferring dark, the root gets data-theme=dark.

risks.text: Should the choice follow the account across devices, or stay per browser?
